name: short-read
title: Handle short reads
lesson: A successful read can return fewer bytes than requested; that is not the same thing as a complete object.
fix_goal: Loop until the required object bytes are read, EOF occurs, or a real error occurs.
fix_steps: Track total bytes read separately from the requested object length.
Advance the destination pointer after each successful short read.
Stop only when the object is complete, EOF is reached, or an error is raised.
